obligations.summary: Providers must establish and document a post-market monitoring system proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.

Providers must ensure their post-market monitoring system actively and systematically collects, documents, and analyses relevant data on the performance of high-risk AI systems throughout their lifetime to evaluate continuous compliance with Chapter III Section 2 requirements, including analysis of interaction with other AI systems where relevant.
exceptions: Sensitive operational data of deployers who are law enforcement authorities are excluded from this obligation.

obligations.summary: Providers must base their post-market monitoring system on a post-market monitoring plan that forms part of the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV.

For high-risk AI systems covered by Union harmonisation legislation listed in Annex I Section A, or financial institution AI systems under Annex III point 5, providers may integrate the required post-market monitoring elements into already existing systems and plans under that legislation, provided an equivalent level of protection is achieved.
exceptions: Integration into existing systems and plans is permitted only where it achieves an equivalent level of protection, avoiding duplication and minimising additional burdens.
